en.name: Thief
en.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
en.flavor: I ain't done nuffink. I weren't even in dat alley last night! It weren't me what stole Mayor Bruno's briefcase wiv all dem fancy dockoments innit. Besides, it was too 'eavy to carry far.

zh.name: 窃贼
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择除你以外的一名玩家：明天白天他的投票会被算作负数。
